description: Create a new user group in JFrog Artifactory with the following details: Group Name: 'developers', Description: 'Development team with access to release repositories'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Security > Groups, click '+ New Group', enter the group name 'developers', add the description 'Development team with access to release repositories', and save. The group 'developers' must be created successfully.

metadata.target_description: Development team with access to release repositories
